title: Look at those black jeans!
grammar: Questions with Which; Answers with one / ones; this / that / these / those; Intensifier too
pair_game: Point at your partner’s clothes. Say the colour and the word: “Red T-shirt!” Then swap!

grammar_box.title: this / that / these / those
grammar_box.tip: one / ones: Which shoes? The white ones. (bittasi / bulari)

questions: Describe what you are wearing today. What color are your clothes?
What is your favorite piece of clothing? Why do you love it?
Do you prefer these jeans or those ones? How do you choose your clothes?
What colors do you like to wear? Are there colors you never wear?
Do you like shopping for clothes? Where do you usually buy them?
What do teenagers in Uzbekistan usually wear to school?
Is there a piece of clothing you think is too expensive? What is it?
Describe the clothes your best friend usually wears.
What do you wear in winter to stay warm? And in summer?
If you could buy any piece of clothing right now, what would it be?
starters: Today I’m wearing a … and … . My … is … .
My favorite piece of clothing is my … . I love it because … .
I prefer these/those … . I choose clothes by … .
I like to wear … and … . I never wear … .
Yes, I like it. / No, I don’t. I usually buy clothes at … .
Teenagers in Uzbekistan usually wear … to school.
My best friend usually wears … and … .
In winter I wear a … . In summer I wear … .
I want to buy … right now.
samples: Describe what you are wearing today. What color are your clothes?
Today I’m wearing a **white** shirt and **black** trousers. My shoes are **black**, too.
Do you prefer these jeans or those ones? How do you choose your clothes?
I prefer **those ones**. **These** jeans are **too** small! I choose clothes by colour.
What do teenagers in Uzbekistan usually wear to school?
Teenagers in Uzbekistan usually wear a white shirt and a dark skirt or trousers to school.

game.title: Clothes spinner
game.rules: Spin the pencil. Read the prompt and answer. Get a point for each good answer!
items: Point and say: This is a … .
Point far and say: Those are … .
Which T-shirt do you like: red or blue?
Say something that is too big for you.
What does your teacher wear today?
Which shoes are better: these or those?

mini_talk.title: My clothes
mini_talk.model: Hi! I’m Madina. Today I’m wearing a white shirt and a blue skirt. My favourite clothes are **these** black jeans. I love pink and purple. I never wear brown. I buy clothes at the bazaar with my mum. Some jackets there are **too** expensive. **Which** **one** do you like?

cando: use this, that, these and those
ask and answer with Which and one / ones
